🧭 Essential local info
Getting around
Capital region metro (Lines 1–9, Shinbundang Line, etc.) + city buses. Integrated transfer system. Transit cards: T-money / Cashbee standard; accepted at most transit + convenience stores.
Late-night travel
Last subway trains depart around midnight–12:30 a.m. by line (outbound slightly later). Night Bus N (Owl Bus) runs main routes after hours. Taxis / Kakao T widely available; late-night surcharges apply.
How to pay
Credit / debit cards · mobile payments (Samsung Pay, etc.) widely accepted. Some small vendors / street stalls prefer cash. QR payments (Kakao Pay / Naver Pay) common.
Currency & exchange
Korean won (KRW, ₩). Since card payments are standard, exchange needs are minimal. Airport / downtown exchange counters / ATMs available.
Language
Korean. Tourist attractions, major concert venues, and transit signs commonly display English—but everyday English proficiency is moderate.
Local apps
카카오T (Taxi, chauffeur, or ride-hailing.) · 네이버 지도 (Transit routes and real-time maps.) · 카카오페이 (QR codes and mobile payment.)
Late-night transit apps
카카오T (Standard for late-night taxis (90%+ market share, fastest matching). Note: restrictions may apply for foreign phone number signup.) · UT(우티/Uber) (Call taxis using your foreign card and number—fully foreigner-friendly.) · 타다(TADA) (Book Carnival vans with your foreign number and card—signup is straightforward.) · i.M(아이엠) (Large-van premium taxi service.) · K-RIDE(케이라이드) (Foreigner-only taxi booking (no KakaoTalk required; Seoul, Incheon, greater Seoul area).) · 올빼미버스(N버스) (After last transit, take the night bus—Seoul's official routes (N15, N16, N26, etc.).)  📶 eSIM ↗
Hailing tips
Main venue plaza gets flooded with requests—walk 1–2 blocks away for faster matching. Alternatively, move one subway stop away to reduce competition.
Around the Venue
롯데월드몰 📍Massive complex at Lotte World Tower's base: Olive Young, duty-free, K-fashion, observation deck all under one roof.
석촌호수 📍Lakeside walk with Lotte World Tower backdrop—prime cherry blossom and night-view photo spot.
